# Recorded fixtures

Shapes captured from the live Brain.fm API on 2026-11-05.
Account-specific values are replaced with placeholders; catalog values (activity
ids, genre names) are real, because they are not personal data.

These are the only record of the shapes `bfm-api` depends on, and they are
executable: a change upstream shows up as a failing test here.
**No test may hit the live API** — CI enforces this.
